situation: Choosing a quantization tier for GLM-family models.
decision: Preference order: (1) official native FP8/W8A8, (2) BF16 for eval/high-risk, (3) calibrated INT8, (4) AWQ/GPTQ/INT4 after validation, (5) fresh community GGUF only for experimentation.
reasoning_physics: Lower precision trades bits for risk of behavioral degradation (tool selection, exact argument construction, refusal). Official FG8 is the safest cost cut; community GGUF is unvalidated and can silently corrupt write-agent reasoning. Cost only where fidelity is proven.
